why: The mark is FFA-only by the owner's direction on #234, and the guard that makes it so is one clause easily read as redundant beside the two it sits with. Dropping it puts a per-slot glyph ahead of a teams entry's pips, which already carries the A/B/C letter as its non-colour channel -- so the entry would state its side twice in two different vocabularies, and a 2v2 would show four different marks for two teams. It is invisible in FFA, which is where every capture is taken. Re-pointed twice: by #230's `marks` arm, which added a clause to the guard, and by #1022, which replaced that clause with the row the strip's rule chose. The mutation still drops only the FFA test.
killedBy: hud: identity mark in the stock strip (issue #778) leaves TEAMS untouched -- the letter is already that entry second channel
hud: the stock strip draws by one rule (issue #1022) draws every cell as the table says: one row per entry, every stock drawn, the leading marks counted
